topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Rain pounds the city, soaking through to the bones. Got a call from a kid, voice cracking like he just found the edge of the world. His words, his thoughts, scribbled down in the dead of night, staring at a computer in a room lit by the cold glow of a screen. Now those same words, same damn thoughts, staring back at him from a college website. Like watching your reflection in a puddle, only to have someone else step into it, rippling the surface, erasing your face. You can fix the ripples, but the face, that's another story. Told him to come by the office, maybe we could find a way to put the pieces back together, or at least find out who decided his words were meant for everyone to see.
